versions.content: With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameters securityEventId and count of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCountContextData . The development error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID shall be reported when an unknown event ID is provided by the service call or the passed count is equal to 0.
